structured.approach:
Attempt 2 fixes the citation refusals and changes no code or docs. The four G2 failures and their fixes:
- file:ap_portal/package.json, ci.mjs, README.md: these were only shown through Bash cat, so the check could not see them. I opened them, plus docs/ap_portal.md and CLAUDE.md, with the Read tool.
- task.code: it is the output, not an input, so it no longer appears as a source.

I re-ran `node ci.mjs` and git status/diff to confirm the working tree is unchanged. I rewrote task.code.md in full so that every source is one of: a step input, tool:repo, record:brief, record:memory, or a file:ap_portal/... opened with Read in this session. I dropped the unresolvable skill citation and marked the "tests come in the unit-test step" point as agent judgement. The implementation itself (renderOverdueRisk, its private helpers, VERSION 2.4.0, README and docs) is as in attempt 1. tests/ and package.json stay outside this step's write scope.
tools_used: Bash (node ci.mjs, git status, git diff --stat)

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk is added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary. Those existing exports are unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array. Otherwise it returns <table class="overdue-risk">, a plain header row (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount), and one <tr class="risk-…"> per row in the given order.

The amount is handled only as a string matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ and is padded to two decimals as text. The code never calls Number(), parseFloat or formatAmount on it, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is limited to the four risk values; any other value renders risk-unknown.
VERSION in index.js is now 2.4.0. package.json still has version 2.3.0 because package.json is outside this step's write scope.

The CI script requires line coverage of at least 90% and has static checks for console.log, eval( and lines over 140 characters. In this step's run the code compiles, the existing tests pass and there are no static issues. CI still fails because coverage is below the bar.
This step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so the new unit tests in tests/portal.test.js are not added here.
README.md lists the helpers and links to docs/ap_portal.md. docs/ap_portal.md documents renderOverdueRisk's inputs, outputs, TypeError cases and a worked example.
The repository rule is to keep existing public signatures and add new functions for new behaviour; the change follows it.

open_questions: CQ-1: CI fails on line coverage alone, below the 90% bar in ci.mjs, until the feat.design B4.5 tests are added. tests/ is outside FE-04's write scope. Is a coverage-only CI failure acceptable for FE-04's automated check?
CQ-2: package.json "version" is 2.3.0 while VERSION is 2.4.0. package.json is outside FE-04's write scope, so a later step needs to set it to 2.4.0.
CQ-3: Confirm 2.4.0 as the minor version step (carried from task.components CQ-FE-2).
Carried unchanged: TQ-6, TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, OQ-B9, OQ-B10, DQ-3, PQ-P7, CQ-FE-1 (styles for the risk-* classes).
structured.summary: STORY-07 is coded in ap_portal: renderOverdueRisk and its private helpers in src/ap_portal/index.js, VERSION 2.4.0, an updated README.md and a new docs/ap_portal.md. Nothing is committed. task.code.md is rewritten with sources that resolve (repository files opened with Read, no self-citation). CI compiles, the existing tests pass and there are no static issues, but CI still fails on line coverage. The new tests belong in tests/, which this step cannot write. package.json's version also needs a later step.
